# sauth_app_settings (Resource)

The app_settings records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) app id
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `value` (Attributes) Settings sections to merge (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--value))

<a id="nestedatt--value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `value`

Optional:

- `status` (Attributes) Public status route (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--value--status))

<a id="nestedatt--value--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `value.status`

Optional:

- `public` (Boolean) Whether the public status route answers for the app, false by default
